description: Harden the ProfilePage manager name editing — add max character limit with counter, refresh display name across app after update, add mock mode support, and add unit tests

userStories.title: Add max character limit and counter to manager name input
userStories.description: As a user, I want the manager name field to enforce a 30-character limit with a visible counter so that names stay readable across the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Manager name TextInput on ProfilePage enforces a 30-character maximum via maxLength prop
A character count indicator is displayed below the input (e.g., '12/30') using Mantine Text or Input.Description
Empty or whitespace-only names are still rejected with an error message (existing behavior preserved)
The save button remains disabled or shows validation error when input is empty
Verify in browser if browser testing tools are available

userStories.title: Refresh display name across app after profile update
userStories.description: As a user, I want my updated manager name to appear immediately in the nav bar and on other pages without refreshing my browser.
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful profile save, the AuthContext or user state refreshes with the new display name
The nav bar header user menu reflects the updated name without a page reload
Standings and draft pages show the updated name on next navigation via fresh React Query fetch
If supabase.auth.updateUser or refreshSession is used, the user_metadata reflects the new display_name

userStories.notes: After the Supabase users table update, call supabase.auth.updateUser({ data: { display_name: newName } }) to sync auth metadata, then refresh the AuthContext state. The nav bar reads from user.user_metadata?.['display_name']. React Query queries that join on users table will pick up the change on next fetch.

userStories.title: Add mock mode support for manager name update
userStories.description: As a developer, I want profile name editing to work in mock mode so that I can develop and test the feature offline.
acceptanceCriteria: A mock profile update handler exists in the mock hooks directory (packages/web/src/mock/hooks/)
The mock handler updates the in-memory user state with the new display name
The mock hooks registry (mockHooksRegistry.ts) includes the profile update mock
Updating the name in mock mode reflects immediately in the nav bar and across the app
The ProfilePage works identically in mock and live mode from the user's perspective

userStories.title: Add unit tests for profile update validation and flow
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tests covering the manager name update logic so that regressions are caught.
acceptanceCriteria: Test that empty or whitespace-only names are rejected
Test that names at exactly 30 characters are accepted
Test that a valid name trims whitespace before saving
Test that successful update triggers a state refresh (display name changes in returned user object)
Test that character count displays correctly for various input lengths
